title: His father stops playing and keeps studying
summary: At about 90 his father writes that he is done playing music; he keeps taking correspondence courses.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Is your dad still playing music?

He doesn’t now. In 1988 or ’89 – I think it was the beginning of ’89 – I had a letter from my father. He said – he always called me Joseph – “Joseph, as of this date, I am no longer playing any more music.” I will play no more music. I’ve had enough music. He named whatever number of years he had been playing. He said, I think that’s enough.
Yeah. That was it. He was almost 90 years old, but he made it. He finally made it.
Wow. He sounds like quite a character.

He is. You’d be surprised. When you see him, you would not believe that he’s 91 years old. You just wouldn’t believe it. Very alert. He’s always studying something. He said, “As long as I study, my mind keeps going.” He took a course in mathematics from – a correspondence course from the University of Chicago. He took a course in sociology. He was just taking a course in English from the University of Pennsylvania, a correspondence course. He said – he called me. He says, “I did very well on the test.”
Was he proud of you? Was he glad that you’d become a musician?
